proposed_rule.title: Raga Recommendation Evidence Gating (proposed)
proposed_rule.summary: No raga may be surfaced as a recommendation candidate for a therapeutic goal tied to a serious medical or psychiatric condition (per raaga/structured/chakra_raga_bridge.json condition_flag) unless (a) the association has evidence_level LEVEL_1-3 and review_status=approved, or (b) it is presented purely as a general relaxation/wellbeing option with explicit non-treatment framing and therapist sign-off. This extends Rule 10 (Responsible Chakra & Raaga Recommendations) with an explicit gate specific to the newly-added ANAHAT practitioner-tradition raga-condition data (LEVEL_5), which was not present in the knowledge base Rule 10 was originally written against.
